title: Pandolfi's uncle a founding member of the OSS
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Pandolfi's uncle a founding member of the OSS, about 1940s-1990s at CIA / OSS, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> And uh he wants the information and it's shut down by Dr. Pandolfe, who by the way, his uncle Louis Pandolfe was a founding member of the OSS.

plain: Jason Simosa, a researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels that when someone tried to get certain UFO information, the request was shut down by a man he calls Dr. Pandolfi. Simosa adds that Pandolfi's uncle, Louis Pandolfi, was a founding member of the OSS, the American wartime spy service that came before the CIA. He tells it to suggest the secrecy runs in families with deep ties to intelligence work.
